titleJa: ほしをさがすロケット
title: Starbound Rocket
description: Painted paper-tube rocket with cut-card fins, craters and a hand-drawn moon.
memo: 紙の筒に色をぬって羽をつけたロケット。手がきの月もうかんでいるよ

title: Rainbow Sailboat
description: A built cardboard hull with ribs, paper sails, twisted cord rigging and layered painted waves.
memo: 段ボールの船に紙の帆をはって、ひもでつないだよ。波も重ねてかいたよ

titleJa: もりのステゴサウルス
title: The Cardboard Stegosaurus
description: A laminated cardboard dinosaur with tube legs, individual back plates and a miniature paper forest.
memo: 段ボールを重ねた恐竜。背中の板を一枚ずつつけて、紙の森も作ったよ

title: Shoebox Aquarium
description: An open shoebox reef with hanging cutout fish, folded seaweed and a sculpted paper turtle.
memo: くつの箱の中に海を作ったよ。魚をつるして、紙のカメも泳いでいるよ

title: Pocket Solar System
description: A freestanding cardboard mobile with painted paper-mache planets, threads and a real Saturn ring.
memo: 紙ねんどの惑星に色をぬって、糸でつるしたよ。土星のわっかもあるよ

title: Butterfly Meadow
description: Individually folded patterned paper wings above a bouquet of creased paper flowers.
memo: もようの紙をおってちょうちょにしたよ。紙の花たばの上をとんでいるよ

title: Rainbow Express
description: A paper-tube steam engine with a windowed cab, eight spoked wheels, couplers and a loaded wagon.
memo: 紙の筒で作った汽車。車輪を八つつけて、荷物をのせた車両もひっぱるよ

title: Forest Birdhouse
description: A real open birdhouse in corrugated board, with individually laid roof shingles and a perched paper bird.
memo: 段ボールで作った小鳥の家。屋根を一枚ずつはって、紙の小鳥もとまっているよ

title: Tulip Windmill
description: A small paper windmill with open lattice sails, a dimensional mill house, and folded tulips.
memo: 紙で作った風車の家。はねを格子にして、まわりにチューリップをおったよ

title: Memory Camera
description: A recycled-card camera with paper lens barrels, a twine strap and original tiny crayon photo cards.
memo: 空き箱で作ったカメラ。紙のレンズとひものストラップ、クレヨンの写真つき

title: Little Fire Engine
description: A dimensional card fire engine with open cab windows, a lattice ladder and a wound cotton hose.
memo: 厚紙で作った消防車。はしごを組んで、ホースは綿の糸をまいたよ

title: Little Bakery
description: A tiny card bakery with a striped folded awning, miniature clay breads, baskets and paper bags.
memo: 厚紙の小さなパン屋さん。しましまの屋根と、ねんどのパンをならべたよ

title: The Wishwheel
description: Two corrugated wheel rings, eight independently assembled gondolas, A-frame supports and a tiny ticket booth.
memo: 段ボールで作った観覧車。ゴンドラを八つつけて、きっぷ売り場もあるよ

titleJa: ちいさな段ボール人形劇場
title: The Little Cardboard Theatre
description: A fully built cardboard theatre with a deep stage, real pleated paper curtains, articulated forest puppets and exposed backstage construction.
memo: 段ボールで作った人形げき場。紙のまくをひだにして、森の人形がならんでいるよ

title: Patchwork Sky Balloon
description: Ten curved paper gores form a hollow balloon above a woven paper basket, with stitched paper seams, string suspension and a real central stand.
memo: 紙を十まいつないだ気球。ぬい目もかいて、紙のかごをひもでつるしたよ

title: The Craft-Stick Biplane
description: An exposed wooden-stick airframe with cambered paper wings, cardboard wheel laminations, crossed bracing strings and an open miniature cockpit.
memo: アイスのぼうで組んだひこうき。紙のつばさを二まい重ねて、ひもでとめたよ

title: Milk-Carton Lighthouse
description: A recycled milk carton becomes a hollow striped lighthouse with cut-through windows, folded carton top, octagonal lantern and individually made rocky shore.
memo: 牛乳パックで作った灯台。しましまにぬって、まどをくりぬいたよ。岩も作ったよ

title: The Tissue-Lava Volcano
description: An uneven papier-mache mountain has a genuine deep crater, crinkled tissue lava streams, folded rock patches and a supported plume of crumpled paper.
memo: 紙をはり重ねた火山。うす紙のマグマが流れて、けむりもふき出しているよ

titleJa: かみの海賊たからばこ
title: The Paper Pirate Treasure
description: A hollow cardboard treasure chest with an opened slatted curved lid, folded foil straps, hand-stamped clay coins and a curled paper map.
memo: 段ボールの海ぞくのたからばこ。アルミはくのかざりと、ねんどの金貨と地図入り

title: The Egg-Carton Crocodile
description: Recycled pulp cups create a bumpy crocodile body, with hinged long jaws, hand-cut paper teeth, clay feet and a tapering folded tail.
memo: たまごパックをつなげたワニ。口がひらいて、紙のきばを一本ずつつけたよ

titleJa: ゆらゆらクラゲの工作
title: Paper Bowl Jellyfish
description: An upside-down painted paper bowl with curled tissue tentacles, a cotton suspension knot, crimped rim and a real wooden display stand.
memo: 紙のおわんをさかさにしたクラゲ。うす紙の足をくるくるさせて、つるしたよ

titleJa: 紙皿ライオンのたてがみ
title: Paper Plate Lion
description: A ridged painted paper plate surrounded by individually curled construction-paper mane loops, with layered ears, cotton whiskers and a folded cardboard easel.
memo: 紙皿のライオン。たてがみは色紙をくるっとまいて、一本ずつはったよ

titleJa: はりねずみの落ち葉のおうち
title: Hedgehog Hideout
description: A thumb-shaped clay hedgehog with individually rolled spines beside a miniature corrugated hideout, folded autumn leaves, acorns and a little apple.
memo: ねんどのはりねずみ。とげを一つずつつけて、落ち葉のおうちとどんぐりも作ったよ

titleJa: 段ボールの海底探検艇
title: Cardboard Submarine
description: A hollow painted-card submarine with genuine round openings, layered foil portholes, a rolled-paper periscope, a three-bladed card propeller and cutout cradles.
memo: 段ボールのせんすいかん。まどにアルミはくをはって、紙のプロペラもつけたよ

title: Origami Crane Wetland
description: Three individually folded paper cranes over a layered pond, with physical bamboo supports, pleated wing backs, reed stems, clay cattails and folded lily pads.
memo: おり紙のつるを三わおったよ。竹ひごで池の上にうかせて、がまの穂もあるよ

titleJa: きのこの小さなおうち
title: Toadstool Cottage
description: A hollow painted paper-cup cottage under a complete red paper mushroom roof, with cutout windows, an opening-style folded door, cream paper gills, twig fencing and a clay snail.
memo: 紙コップのきのこのおうち。赤い屋根に、まどとドア、ねんどのかたつむりもいるよ

title: A Turtle for the Sea
description: Hand-shaped air-dry clay turtle, individually raised shell scutes, thumb dents, soft flippers and a paper tide pool.
memo: ねんどでうみがめを作ったよ。こうらのもようを一つずつもり上げたよ

titleJa: あきかんドラムセット
title: Kitchen-Can Orchestra
description: A child-built orchestra with open recycled can shells, taut paper skins, pleated paper-plate cymbals and taped wooden stands.
memo: あきかんでドラムセットを作ったよ。紙皿のシンバルもたたけるよ

titleJa: かみのラッパのちくおんき
title: The Paper Song Machine
description: A folded-paper horn, cardboard record, rolled paper tonearm and a hand-cranked corrugated music box.
memo: 紙のラッパのちくおんき。段ボールのレコードと、まわすハンドルもあるよ

titleJa: あみあみピクニックかご
title: The Paper Picnic
description: An open basket woven from individual over-under kraft strips, laminated arch handles, a folded gingham paper liner and clay picnic food.
memo: 紙のテープをあみあみしたピクニックかご。ねんどのおべんとうも入っているよ

title: The Accordion Peacock
description: An individually pleated fan tail with crayon eye patterns, a rolled paper body, layered paper wings and a three-dimensional folded beak.
memo: おり紙のくじゃく。はねをじゃばらにおって、クレヨンで目玉もようをかいたよ

title: Popsicle River Crossing
description: A true craft-stick truss bridge with overlapping rounded timber members, string lashings, corrugated abutments and a folded paper boat below.
memo: アイスのぼうを組んだはし。ひもでしばって、下には紙のふねがういているよ

titleJa: ダンボールのショベルカー
title: Little Digger Workshop
description: An open-window corrugated excavator with laminated boom plates, visible pivot pins, working-looking hydraulic rods, individual track links and an open scoop.
memo: 段ボールのショベルカー。うでがのびて、キャタピラも一つずつつなげたよ
